Finite checks are independent examples, not substitutes for the algebraic proof.

value.rationale: Bistars are a natural two-center branching tree family not subsumed by stars. The exact primitive orbit count, all conserved-total residue populations and both-phase nonnegative generating function answer an invariant-resource question not addressed by the known period-two theorem. The balanced tied-bridge branch produces a sharp, uniquely attained one-chip lower threshold. This is an infinite-family classification of recurrent behavior, not an arbitrary finite slice.
